title: Sharp Identification for Regression with Interval-Observed and Missing Covariates
abstract: arXiv:2611.03345v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Researchers frequently estimate regressions when key variables are missing or observed only through intervals. Imputation or assumptions about the observation process can yield seemingly precise but misleading conclusions. We develop methods for identification and inference that remain robust to such incomplete data. For a broad class of conditional moment models, we characterize the sharp identified set, the set of all parameter values consistent with the observed data and maintained regression model, without restricting how incomplete observations arise. We establish Hausdorff-consistent estimation and uniformly valid confidence regions, and develop computationally tractable implementations for common regression models. In an application relating interval-elicited discount rates to on-time high-school graduation, conventional inference excludes zero, whereas our interval-data-robust confidence regions include it. translated_title: 区间观测与缺失协变量回归的精确识别
translated_abstract: 研究人员在估计回归模型时，经常遇到关键变量缺失或仅能通过区间形式观测的情况。插补方法或对观测过程施加的假设可能产生看似精确却具有误导性的结论。我们开发了对此类不完整数据保持稳健的识别与推断方法。对于一大类条件矩模型，我们在不限制不完整观测如何产生的条件下，刻画了精确识别集——即与观测数据及所维护回归模型相一致的所有参数值的集合。我们建立了Hausdorff一致估计量和一致有效的置信区域，并为常见回归模型开发了计算上易于实现的方案。在一项关于区间引导引出的贴现率与按时高中毕业之间关系的实证应用中，传统推断排除了零值，而我们针对区间数据稳健的置信区域则包含零值。利用精确识别...
tldr: 该论文针对协变量缺失或仅以区间形式观测的回归问题，在不限制不完整观测产生机制的条件下刻画了精确识别集，建立了Hausdorff一致估计与一致有效的置信区域，并通过实证应用表明传统推断方法可能产生误导性结论。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes the sharp identified set for regressions with missing or interval-observed covariates without restricting how incompleteness arises, establishes Hausdorff-consistent estimation and uniformly valid confidence regions, and shows empirically that conventional inference can yield misleading conclusions.
